metadata.title: Retro Soft-Focus Portrait with Geometric Display Type

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus portrait of a man with dark, voluminous wavy hair against a textured, multi-tonal gradient background, featuring bold, stylized geometric typography at the top corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark hair mass contrasting against a muted, grainy background
Warm skin tones harmonizing with the orange-yellow typography
Symmetrical shoulder placement anchoring the central face
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and airbrushed texture
Soft-focus lens effect on facial features
High-contrast dark hair against a lighter, hazy backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, head occupying the upper-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark silhouette of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the hair, then out to the text in the top corners, following the curve of the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial textured space around the head and shoulders, particularly in the top corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (browns, grays, and deep reds) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange-yellow for the typography and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the hair and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both corner elements to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s geometric aesthetic and circular 'O' forms.
Matches the rounded, heavy geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, grainy 1970s-style portrait of a man with large, dark wavy hair. Use a muted, textured background with a gradient of gray, brown, and deep red. The lighting should be warm and diffuse.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-bold geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. The text should be a warm orange-yellow color with a slight grain to match the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the image?
Is the hair silhouette distinct from the background?
Is the typography placed strictly in the top corners?
Does the color palette feel authentically 1970s?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the background gradient
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are visible.
Check that the text color complements the skin tones.
Verify the soft-focus effect does not obscure the eyes entirely.
Confirm the background texture feels like airbrushed paper or aged film.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus analog portrait with corner-aligned geometric display type to evoke a 1970s studio aesthetic.
